claims.content: To open an entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) to allow vehicles to enter the RLCS facility from the adjacent main lanes of I-15 or SR-163 in a specific direction of travel.

goal.raw_text: To open an entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) to allow vehicles to enter the RLCS facility from the adjacent main lanes of I-15 or SR-163 in a specific direction of travel.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator must be authenticated and logged into the RLCS system.
The Operator must possess a Command Level security attribute of either 'Control' or 'Override' to issue device control commands.
The status of any opposite direction entrance closure device must not be 'unknown' or 'open'.
The system must have current status information for all entrance closure devices maintained at the control unit.
The Operator issues a command to open an entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) for a specific direction of travel.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator issues a command to open an entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) for a specific direction of travel.

claims.content: The Operator issues a command to open an entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) for a specific direction of travel.
The system validates that the status of any opposite direction entrance closure device is not 'unknown' or 'open'.
The system executes the opening sequence, starting with the Barrier Gate as the first step in the defined order.
The system monitors the command execution and waits for completion within the specific 'response time window' defined for the compound command.
Upon successful completion, the system updates the status of the entrance closure device and forwards this status immediately to all other control units in the system.
If the status of any opposite direction entrance closure device is 'unknown' or 'open', the control system must not attempt to open the requested entrance closure device.
If the status of any opposite direction entrance closure device is 'unknown' or 'open', the control system must not attempt to open the requested entrance closure device.
If a command fails to complete within its specific 'response time window' defined for successful command completion, the system shall log the failure and alert the Operator.

If the Operator attempts to issue a command without possessing the required Command Level security attribute ('Control' or 'Override'), the system shall deny the command and log the unauthorized access attempt.
The status of the opened entrance closure device (Barrier Gate) is updated in all control units.
The current status information for all entrance closure devices is maintained at each control unit.
A Device Command Log entry is created recording the command execution details including Date, Time, and Operator ID.
